acquisition_method.evidence: Following the enrichment protocol, more than two thousand proteins can routinely be quantified reproducibly by label-free quantification and data independent acquisition (DIA) in single-shot LC-MSMS runs of less than one hour.
The mass spectrometer was operated in positive mode using either data-dependent-acquisition (DDA) or data-independent-acquisition (DIA) modes.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: For PAC digestion the samples were reduced and alkylated 30 min at RT with 5 mM TCEP, 10 mM CAA in 1% SDS.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Magnetic beads (MagReSyn hydroxyl beads, cat# MR-HYX2L, ReSyn Biosciences, Ltd, South Africa), were added at protein:bead ratios of 1:6 to the 20k EV fraction and 1:2 to the unfractionated plasma and left to incubate for 20 min in 70% ACN at RT. The beads was washed once with 100% ACN and once with 70% ethanol before endoproteinase Lys-C  (Cat# 129-02541, FUJIFILM Wako Pure Chemical Corporation, Richmond, VA) was added 1:250 (enzyme to protein ratio) for 1.5 h incubation on a thermoshaker at 37 °C in 50 mM HEPES buffer at pH 7.5.
Trypsin (Cat# V5111, Promega) was added 1:100 (enzyme to protein ratio) for overnight incubation on a thermoshaker at 37 °C.

ionization_type.evidence: 500 ng peptides (NanoDrop, A280) were loaded on Evotips and eluted over 11, 22 or 44 min gradients (Solvent A: 5 % ACN, 0.1 % Formic Acid, solvent B  99.9% ACN, 0.1% Formic Acid) using an EvoSep One system connected to a 150 mm analytical column packed with C18 beads (1.9 um, cat# r119.aq.0003, Dr. Maisch) maintained at 60 °C using a column oven. Eluting peptides were sprayed into an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer applying 2 kV spray voltage, RF funnel at 40%, and ion transfer tube temperature set to 275 °C.
